import numpy as np

def scaled_dot_product_attention(Q, K, V, mask=None):
    d_k = K.shape[-1]
    scores = np.matmul(Q, K.T) / np.sqrt(d_k)
    if mask is not None:
        scores = scores + mask * -1e9
    e_x = np.exp(scores - np.max(scores, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    attn = e_x / np.sum(e_x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return np.matmul(attn, V)

def multi_head_attention(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, num_heads):
    Q = np.matmul(x, W_q)
    K = np.matmul(x, W_k)
    V = np.matmul(x, W_v)
    d_k = K.shape[-1] // num_heads
    heads = []
    for i in range(num_heads):
        q_h = Q[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        k_h = K[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        v_h = V[:, i*d_k:(i+1)*d_k]
        head_out = scaled_dot_product_attention(q_h, k_h, v_h)
        heads.append(head_out)
    concat = np.concatenate(heads, axis=-1)
    return np.matmul(concat, W_o)
